title: Alien Dictionary
summary: The words are listed in sorted order under an unknown alphabet.

contractDetails.output-checking: Check that every observed letter appears once and the words are sorted under the returned order. Accept an empty string only for an impossible dictionary.

statement: The words are listed in sorted order under an unknown alphabet. Return any string containing each observed letter once that makes the list sorted. Return an empty string when no alphabet order works.

examples.explanation: The first pair implies a before b. The second implies p before r.
A word must precede its longer extensions, so the supplied order is impossible.
One word imposes no ordering on its distinct letters.

hints: Conceptual: Compare neighboring words and look for the first position where they differ.
Directional: That mismatch establishes a directed precedence rule. A longer word before its own prefix is impossible.
Implementation: Include every observed letter, deduplicate precedence edges, and topologically sort. A cycle prevents a complete order.
complexityAnalysis: O(L + A²) time and O(A²) auxiliary space with an adjacency matrix, where L is the total number of letters and A ≤ 26.
